eval_command: cd /repo && rm -rf results/ && python3 run_mfld.py --dataset student_teacher --seed 0 --particle_num 256 --step_size 0.01 --noise_scale 0.001 --bandwidth 1.0 --step_num 1000 --thinning kt --kernel sobolev --zeta 0.0001 --d 12 --teacher_num 100 --g 0 --kt_function compresspp_kt && python3 -c "import numpy as np, glob; d=sorted(glob.glob('results/neural_network_student_teacher/thinning_kt/*__complete'))[-1]; tl=np.load(d+'/test_losses.npy'); print(f'Test Loss: {float(tl[-1]):.10f}')"
eval_output_format: Final test loss printed as 'Test Loss: X.XXXXXXXXXX' to stdout.
known_levers: Safe levers for SOTA optimization: step_num (more training steps), particle_num N (more particles improve performance at higher cost), g (KT oversampling, 0/1/2 trades cost for accuracy), step_size (learning rate), noise_scale sigma, zeta (L2 regularization strength), kt_function (compresspp_kt KT-MFLD1 vs compress_kt KT-MFLD2), kernel type (sobolev vs gaussian), d (input dimension), teacher_num (teacher network complexity).
setup_notes: Base image: pytorch/pytorch:2.1.0-cuda12.1-cudnn8-runtime. Installed JAX 0.6.2 with CUDA 12 GPU support via nvidia-cuda-* pip packages including cuDNN 9.24.0.43 and nvcc 12.9.86. Compiled goodpoints 0.6.2 from source with gcc. Container uses 2x A100-80GB GPUs. No external datasets needed (synthetic student-teacher data).

optimization_objective.summary: Minimize test loss (MSE) on Student-Teacher Network for KT-MFLD.

metrics.name: Test Loss
metrics.rationale: Primary paper metric comparing KT-MFLD variants and baselines.

optimization_objective.success_policy: Improve Test Loss (lower is better). Any reduction is a win.
